title: CANAL: Channel-Aware Noise Allocation for Differentially Private Feature Distillation in Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13271v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image segmentation needs diverse training data, but hospitals hold complementary scans they cannot share for privacy and regulatory reasons. Knowledge distillation can bridge this gap by exporting learned feature representations instead of images, but those representations still encode patient-specific anatomy and remain vulnerable to membership-inference and feature-inversion attacks. Adding calibrated Gaussian noise restores a differential-privacy guarantee, yet three issues have been overlooked. First, prior DP feature-distillation pipelines re-sample noise at every student iteration, so each patient image is released many times and the privacy cost composes over those releases, growing by orders of magnitude. We present a sample-once-per-image release, realized by a single precomputation pass, under which each patient contributes one release. Second, uniform noise is wasteful because channels differ in task importance. Usin

translated_title: CANAL：面向医学图像分割中差分隐私特征蒸馏的信道感知噪声分配
translated_abstract: 医学图像分割需要多样化的训练数据，但医院出于隐私和监管原因无法共享各自持有的互补性扫描影像。知识蒸馏可以通过导出学习到的特征表示而非图像本身来弥合这一差距，但这些表示仍然编码了患者特定的解剖信息，容易受到成员推断攻击和特征反演攻击。添加校准的高斯噪声可以恢复差分隐私保证，但已有研究忽视了三个问题。首先，以往的差分隐私特征蒸馏流程在学生模型的每次迭代中都重新采样噪声，导致每张患者图像被多次发布，隐私成本随这些发布不断累加，增长达数个数量级。我们提出了一种每张图像仅发布一次的方案，通过单次预计算过程实现，使每位患者只贡献一次发布。其次，均匀噪声是浪费的，因为不同信道在任务重要性上存在差异。使用……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CANAL框架，通过每张图像仅一次发布的预计算机制避免隐私成本随迭代反复累加，并根据信道任务重要性进行非均匀噪声分配，从而在医学图像分割的差分隐私特征蒸馏中兼顾患者隐私保护与分割性能。
en_tdlr: CANAL proposes a sample-once-per-image precomputation scheme to avoid privacy cost composition from repeated releases and allocates noise non-uniformly based on channel task importance, enabling differentially private feature distillation for medical image segmentation with strong utility.
